incompatible_conditions.text: Remedy support: the mapping yields a candidate dependency set for a bounded remedy test but not a supported remedy; run that test by removing, pinning or modifying the identified dependencies in the real release workflow and measuring publication failure rate over a defined number of runs against baseline.
incompatible_conditions.rationale: The condition requires intervention and outcome measurement in the real release workflow, whereas the frozen mapping stops at a minimal set for a future remedy test. Fulfilling it would extend the mapped operation and inferential claim. This is an instantiation demand but incompatible with admitting this unchanged packet under an applicability-only assumption.

incompatible_conditions.text: Service-to-change attribution: obtain the deployment record of which changes modified which services in the localized set, then confirm by reverting or bisecting those changes on the harness and observing the localized delay disappear; this moves the inference from 'which services' to 'which deployed change'.
incompatible_conditions.rationale: The deployment linkage is empirical, but the added revert/bisection confirmation extends the frozen inversion operation and inference. This condition is incompatible with unchanged-mapping admission; the Invalid gate independently controls the holdout.
